verdict.rationale: uv is a local CLI that runs entirely on the user's own machines. It can be installed without Rust or Python via curl or pip, or through the standalone installer. It can update itself in place with `uv self update`, and a user reports running it on a shared server without root access, so there is no vendor-hosted dependency for the core tool. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license or of building from source, and documentation of offline/air-gapped use or pointing uv at self-hosted package indexes.
